breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero by symmetry, but for a simply supported beam under a midspan point load the slope is zero at midspan, not at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification removes the incorrect claim that slope vanishes at the supports. It only retains 'The slope vanishes at midspan,' which is physically correct for a symmetric loading condition. The critical error — asserting zero slope at the supports of a simply supported beam — has been eliminated, aligning with the ground truth's intent of not imposing incorrect boundary conditions.
